Definition: from G2417; to be a temple-robber (figuratively):--commit sacrilege.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, hierosyléō means commit sacrilege. It occurs just once, in Romans.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe hierosyléō needs no more than its plain sense — commit sacrilege.
